user.description: Pick the climate to drive and (optionally) the supporting sensors/switches. The controller does not create a new thermostat: it commands the existing one.

init.title: Clima Smart parameters
init.description: Values used by the logic. The times delimit the phases: GAP (off) from the morning start to the day start; DAY until the night start; NIGHT the rest.

data.eco_band: Eco hysteresis (°C): eco OFF at target+band
data.auto_start_sleep: Start the unit when the deep-night window opens
data.auto_start_room: Start by itself when the room goes above (°C)
data.auto_start_house: ...or when the other rooms average goes above (°C)
data.auto_start_outdoor: Only if it is at least this warm outside (°C)
data.vane_sleep_position: Vane position during the deep night

data_description.auto_start_sleep: If the unit is off at that time, it is switched on once. Outside that moment the controller never starts it by itself.
data_description.auto_start_room: Daytime start: if the unit is off and the room goes above this, it is switched on once a day. 0 disables it.
data_description.auto_start_house: Second condition for the daytime start, independent of the room threshold. 0 disables it.
data_description.auto_start_outdoor: No daytime start below this outdoor temperature. 0 removes the guard.
data_description.vane_sleep_position: Usually `swing`: keeps the air moving instead of pointing it at the bed. Outside the deep night the vanes are left alone.

error.invalid_time_order: Times must be in order: morning off < day < night.
error.invalid_eco_range: "Eco ON when outdoor below" must be lower than "Eco OFF when outdoor above".
error.invalid_sleep_window: Deep night cannot start and end at the same time
error.invalid_wind_down: The deep-night window must end before the morning switch-off
error.invalid_presence_state: The presence “home” state cannot be empty

state.smart: Adaptive (fixed target, fan and program decided for you)

eco_on_not_below_off.message: The “eco outdoor ON below” threshold must be lower than “eco outdoor OFF above”.

eco_off_not_above_on.message: The “eco outdoor OFF above” threshold must be higher than “eco outdoor ON below”.

duplicate_aux_switch.message: Eco, mute and night mode must use distinct switches.
